checks.name: llms.txt links point to markdown

checks.name: llms.txt directive in HTML
checks.description: Whether HTML pages include a directive pointing to llms.txt
checks.message: No llms.txt directive found in any of 50 sampled pages
checks.resolution: No agent-facing directive pointing to llms.txt was detected in the HTML of any tested page. Add a visually-hidden element near the top of each page (e.g., a div with CSS clip-rect) containing a link to your llms.txt. If your site serves markdown versions of pages, mention that in the directive too so agents know to request it.

checks.message: 0/50 sampled pages support .md URLs (0%)
checks.resolution: Your pages don't return markdown when .md is appended to the URL. Configure your docs platform to serve .md variants for all documentation pages.

checks.resolution: Your server ignores Accept: text/markdown and returns HTML. Some agents (Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode) request markdown this way. Configure your server to honor content negotiation.
